display_title: Boss, Why Are You Carrying a Whale?
description:
*“Team Leader, why are you wearing a whale?”*

Because of her brother’s overprotection, Ha-Yan couldn’t even attend company dinners, let alone casual drinking parties. Then one day, when her brother’s business trip and her parents’ overseas trip overlapped, the team that always had lunch meetings was scheduled for dinner. Ha-Yan was so happy that she drank until her nose was twisted. When she came to, she saw the naked body of her team leader, Hyun-Woo. And she didn’t know why the thing on Hyun-Woo’s body looked that way. And she decided not to miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that would never come again.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bimil Danpyeonseon (비밀 단편선) Collection.*
